keyPhrases.text: try-hard set dressing clogging up Circle in the Square
enervating effect of so aggressively clickbaity and uncurious a production
there's no great proof of the play's contemporary resonance
surface is all there is — indifferent dignity with a heavy glaze of alikeness

reasoning: Harsh, sustained criticism throughout with no meaningful praise. The reviewer systematically dismantles the production as 'try-hard,' 'uncurious,' lacking coherence and depth. The tone is dismissive and the critique is fundamental, attacking the director's vision and execution. This represents a clear pan.
